questions.explanation: 대화의 맥락상 북극곰이 위험에 처한 이유는 '지구 온난화(global warming)'이고, 이것을 늦출 수 있다는 내용과 일치한다.

options: The bus ran by the stop.
I saw many trees by the road.
The house is heated by using gas.
The decision was made by the company president.
questions.question:
[지문]
G: Jinsu, did you know that polar bears are in danger?
B: Yes. I read about it in an article. It's because of __ⓐ__.
G: Right. Their homes are melting away and their food is disappearing.
B: We should do something about it.
G: How can we slow down __ⓐ__?
B: Well, we can start ⓑ by saving energy.
G: Right. We need to turn off the lights when we leave the room.
B: That's a good idea.

밑줄 친 ⓑ와 같은 용법으로 사용된 것은?
questions.explanation: 'by saving energy'는 '~함으로써(수단/방법)'의 의미이다. 같은 용법은 'by using gas'(가스를 사용함으로써)이다. 다른 선택지들은 by가 '~근처에', '~까지', '~옆에', '~에 의해' 등의 의미로 사용되었다.

options: Earth Hour is held in a particular country every year.
Minho explains to Linda in detail what people should do in Earth Hour.
Linda does not exactly know when to turn off the lights in Earth Hour.
Minho and Linda watched the program about the health on TV together.
Minho and Linda are going to search for more information about the TV program on the Internet.
questions.question:
[지문]
Minho: Linda, did you see the TV program, The Sick Planet?
Linda: Yes, I did. I'm worried about our planet.
Minho: Me, too. We should take action to save the Earth.
Linda: You're right. Hey! Why don't we participate in Earth Hour?
Minho: Earth Hour What's that?
Linda: It's a world movement for the environment.
Minho: Sounds great! Do you know how to take part in it?
Linda: Sure. We turn off our lights together for an hour.
Minho: That's so simple! So, when do we do it?
Linda: I'm not sure. It's different every year.
Minho: Let's look it up on the Internet.

다음 대화의 내용으로 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation:
① Earth Hour는 매년 다른 날에 열린다고 했지, 특정 국가라고 하지 않았다.
② Minho는 설명하지 않고 Linda가 설명한다.
③ Linda가 'I'm not sure. It's different every year.'라고 정확히 언제인지 모른다고 했다. (O)
④ 함께 봤다는 언급이 없다.
⑤ TV 프로그램에 대해서가 아니라 Earth Hour에 대해 찾아보려고 한다.

questions.question:
다음 중 대화 흐름이 어색한 것은?

① A: My brother broke his leg.
B: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.

② A: I'm worried about hungry children in Africa.
B: Me, too. It's terrible.

③ A: Yellow dust does a lot of harm to your body.
B: Okay, I'll wear a mask.

④ A: Do you turn off the lights when you leave a room?
B: Yes. We should keep the room bright.

⑤ A: My neck hurts. Do you know how to prevent text neck?
B: Yes. You need to stretch your neck often.
questions.explanation: ④번에서 A는 '방을 떠날 때 불을 끈다'고 물었는데, B는 'We should keep the room bright(방을 밝게 유지해야 한다)'라고 답했다. 이는 불을 끄는 것과 모순되므로 대화 흐름이 어색하다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Why are bees disappearing? (A) One of the reasons is climate change. (B) Global warming has brought extremely hot and cold weather. (C) Bees cannot survive in these climate conditions. (D) These chemicals kill not only bad insects, but also good insects, like bees. (E)

다음 문장이 들어가기에 가장 알맞은 곳은?

Another reason is the harmful chemicals farmers use on crops.
questions.explanation: Another reason(또 다른 이유)이라는 것은 앞에 다른 이유가 제시되었다는 것을 의미한다. 새로운 원인인 해로운 화학물질이 제시되고 있으므로 화학물질에 대한 설명이 시작되는 (D)에 들어가야 한다.
